DEWA and Dubai Municipality sign an MoU on the Hatta Sustainable Waterfalls project, strengthening cooperation in managing, operating and developing its facilities, supporting the sustainability of its assets and maximising their benefits for Hatta’s residents and visitors. Signed during WETEX 2026, the agreement transfers responsibility for managing, operating, maintaining and developing the existing buildings, facilities and assets at Hatta Sustainable Waterfalls to Dubai Municipality. The scale of this international gathering reflects WETEX’s standing as a global platform for investment, innovation and cooperation across the energy, water and environmental sectors.
